title: Arrival at the Collegium
introNarration:
A hedgehog in a too-large porter's coat bustles out from the lanterns, quills neatly combed, a brass whistle bouncing on a ribbon.

"Welcome, new Collegian! I am Porter Bramble, and I have been waiting for someone just your height."

"The courtyard is a talking place. Type look to see it properly. Type say hello so I know you arrived. There is a small copper key on the stones — type take key when you are ready. When you have it, walk north into the Great Hall."

"If you forget a word, type help. Type quests to see your first task: Arrival at the Collegium."
reminderNarration: Porter Bramble nods from the lanterns. "Still finding your feet? Type help if a word slips, or quests to see Arrival at the Collegium."

objectives.label: Say hello so Porter knows you arrived
Walk north to the Great Hall
